create_custom_scheduler: create a custom pruning scheduler from a calc expression string with math functions and settings
build_linear_scheduler: build a linear pruning scheduler that ramps sparsity from init to final over a training range
build_cubic_scheduler: build a cubic pruning scheduler using polynomial decay with exponent 3
build_multi_step_scheduler: build a multi-step pruning scheduler that jumps to predefined sparsity levels at given indices
test_pruning_factory: test the PruningSchedulerFactory registry and create_scheduler dispatch for registered and custom scheduler types
